Welcome to RV PU College, E-City (RVPU E-City), a vibrant campus at the heart of Bangalore’s leading technology hub. Our mission is to provide a supportive and inspiring learning environment that empowers students to reach their full potential.

As a pre-university college, we offer comprehensive education designed to prepare young adults for higher studies and future careers. With experienced faculty, modern classrooms, state-of-the-art facilities and abundant resources, we focus on nurturing both academic excellence and personal growth. At RVPU E-City, we aim to shape well-rounded, confident and successful individuals ready to thrive in an ever-evolving world.

We have opened doors to learning across Bengaluru, with campuses thoughtfully located to bring quality education closer to you. Each branch carries the same commitment to academic excellence, holistic growth and a student-first environment, yet each has a unique culture shaped by its community and surroundings.

Whether you seek an energetic academic hub, a calm learning atmosphere or a space that balances creativity and discipline, you’ll find a campus that feels just right. Explore our centres, learn what makes them special and choose the environment that empowers you to grow, achieve and thrive.

From academic achievements and cultural celebrations to sports victories, student-led initiatives and inspiring guest sessions, our campus is always alive with energy, creativity and talent. Dive into the experiences that define student life at RVPU E-City.

<script>
(function() {
  function setupInfiniteCarousel(carouselSelector, prevSelector, nextSelector, desktopCount, gapDesktop) {
    const container = document.querySelector(carouselSelector + ' .swiper, ' + carouselSelector + ' .swiper-container');
    if (!container) return;
    const wrapper = container.querySelector('.swiper-wrapper');
    if (!wrapper || wrapper.dataset.ecityInit === '1') return;

    if (container.swiper && typeof container.swiper.destroy === 'function') {
      try { container.swiper.destroy(false, false); } catch (e) {}
    }

    const rawSlides = Array.from(wrapper.querySelectorAll('.swiper-slide:not(.swiper-slide-duplicate)'));
    if (rawSlides.length < 2) return;
    wrapper.dataset.ecityInit = '1';

    const origHTML = rawSlides.map(function(s) { return s.outerHTML; });
    const N = origHTML.length;
    wrapper.innerHTML = origHTML.concat(origHTML).concat(origHTML).join('');
    const allSlides = Array.from(wrapper.children);

    container.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    container.style.width = '100%';
    wrapper.style.display = 'flex';
    wrapper.style.flexWrap = 'nowrap';
    wrapper.style.boxSizing = 'border-box';
    wrapper.style.willChange = 'transform';

    let currentIndex = N;
    let isAnimating = false;

    function getVisibleCount() {
      if (window.innerWidth <= 767) return 1;
      if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) return 2;
      return desktopCount;
    }

    function getGapPx() {
      if (window.innerWidth <= 767) return 16;
      return Math.round((window.innerWidth / 1920) * gapDesktop);
    }

    function getSlideStep() {
      const vis = getVisibleCount();
      const gapPx = getGapPx();
      const cWidth = container.clientWidth || 1200;
      const slideW = (cWidth - gapPx * (vis - 1)) / vis;
      return { vis: vis, gapPx: gapPx, slideW: slideW, step: slideW + gapPx };
    }

    function applyClasses(animate) {
      const m = getSlideStep();
      allSlides.forEach(function(s) {
        s.style.width = m.slideW + 'px';
        s.style.minWidth = m.slideW + 'px';
        s.style.maxWidth = m.slideW + 'px';
        s.style.marginRight = m.gapPx + 'px';
        s.style.flexShrink = '0';
        s.style.boxSizing = 'border-box';
      });
      wrapper.style.transition = animate ? 'transform 520ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)' : 'none';
      const offset = -(currentIndex * m.step);
      wrapper.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + offset + 'px, 0, 0)';
    }

    function nextSlide() {
      if (isAnimating) return;
      isAnimating = true;
      currentIndex += 1;
      applyClasses(true);
    }

    function prevSlide() {
      if (isAnimating) return;
      isAnimating = true;
      currentIndex -= 1;
      applyClasses(true);
    }

    wrapper.addEventListener('transitionend', function(e) {
      if (e.target !== wrapper) return;
      isAnimating = false;
      if (currentIndex >= 2 * N) {
        currentIndex -= N;
        applyClasses(false);
      } else if (currentIndex < N) {
        currentIndex += N;
        applyClasses(false);
      }
    });

    applyClasses(false);
    window.addEventListener('resize', function() { applyClasses(false); });

    const prevBtn = document.querySelector(prevSelector);
    const nextBtn = document.querySelector(nextSelector);
    if (prevBtn) {
      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        prevSlide();
        resetTimer();
      });
    }
    if (nextBtn) {
      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        nextSlide();
        resetTimer();
      });
    }

    let timer = setInterval(nextSlide, 2800);
    function resetTimer() {
      clearInterval(timer);
      timer = setInterval(nextSlide, 2800);
    }
    container.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() { clearInterval(timer); });
    container.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() { resetTimer(); });
  }

  function initAll() {
    setupInfiniteCarousel('.ecity-results-carousel', '.ecity-results-prev', '.ecity-results-next', 4, 31);
    setupInfiniteCarousel('.ecity-events-carousel', '.ecity-events-prev', '.ecity-events-next', 3, 27);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() { setTimeout(initAll, 250); });
  } else {
    setTimeout(initAll, 250);
  }
  window.addEventListener('load', function() { setTimeout(initAll, 450); });
})();
